Hello,

I'm following up on my email from September 19 about order #Shop····.

The overclocking kit I purchased with this order was never received. Could
you send the over clocking kit? It still looks to be available.

https://heliumdeploy.com/products/overclocking-bundle

Thank you,
Kevin
Note to the team: I'll look up the order first.
Handed to the team · Overclocking line paid and unshipped since Jul 3; its ShipBob shipment was cance

Hi Kevin,

Thanks for following up, and I'm sorry you've been chasing this since July without a straight answer from us. That's on us.

You're right that the Overclocking Bundle is still on order Shop····, paid for and not shipped, so there's no need to swap it for anything. Here's the honest picture: we don't have any on the shelf in the US warehouse right now. The next stock is due in and ships by November 29, 2026, and your kit goes out with it. I've asked our warehouse team to make sure your line is queued against that batch, and a colleague picks that up tomorrow at 10am ET. You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

For the wait and the silence, I've put $50 off your next order on this, code HD-••••••. It's yours alone and works on orders over $200.

If you'd rather not wait until the end of November, just reply and tell me, and I'll go through what else we can do with that line.

Best regards,
Sarah H. Support
That would be great. Thank you

Hi Kevin,

Great, I'll leave it exactly as it is then. The O. Bundle stays on order Shop····, paid, and it ships with the next stock by November 29, 2026. Nothing further for you to do, and nothing more to pay.

You'll get the tracking email automatically when it leaves the warehouse. In the meantime you can watch that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your $50 code for the wait is HD-••••••, good on your next order over $200 whenever you want to use it.

Thanks for your patience with this one, Kevin, and just reply here if anything changes on your end.

Best regards,
Sarah H. Support
